name: K J Somaiya Institute of Management (KJSIM)

programs.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA)
programs.feeNote: Batch 2026-28 fee: Year 1 (2026-27) INR 11,52,000 + Year 2 (2027-28) INR 12,35,500; includes tuition, development, examination, convocation and alumni association fees. Hostel charged separately. 2027-29 batch fee not yet shown on the admission page.
programs.intakeNote: MBA intake 600 seats + supernumerary seats per the MBA admission page (2027-29 cycle). Separate programmes: MBA-HCM 30, MBA-SM 30, MBA-MC 30.
programs.placementNote: MBA 2024-26 per KJSIM placement highlights page: median CTC INR 12 LPA, highest INR 29.30 LPA, 210 recruiters. Placement brochure 2026-27 gives top 10% avg 19.88 LPA, top 20% 17.85 LPA, top 30% 16.86 LPA and says the audited report is awaited. Overall average not clearly stated for this batch, so left null. Earlier batches audited by CRISIL.

selectionProcess.name: Entrance exam
selectionProcess.detail: CAT 2026, XAT 2027, GMAT (taken 1 Jan 2024 - 20 Jan 2027), NMAT (best of two attempts) or CMAT 2027. Minimum 50% aggregate in a 3-year bachelor's degree.

selectionProcess.name: Shortlisting (merit-based or profile-based)
selectionProcess.detail: Profile-based track requires 12-42 months of work experience.

selectionProcess.name: Problem Situation Analysis (PSA) and Personal Interview (PI)
Merit list and online seat allotment
selectionProcess.detail: Composite of entrance score, academics, work experience, PSA, WAT, PI.

keyDates.notes: 2027-29 admissions open; early-bird scholarship deadline 7 Dec 2026 (11:59 PM). Shortlisting/WAT/PSA-PI dates for 2027-29 not yet published (page still lists the 2026 cycle: WAT 16-18 Feb 2026, PSA-PI 20 Feb - 8 Mar 2026).
